newsitem.title: USA: Celadon Group sees Q1 FY97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Celadon Group sees Q1 FY97 profit.

text.p: Celadon Group Inc said Monday it expects to post a profit in the fiscal 1997 first quarter ending in September.

"Based on July and August results, we are confident we will be solidly profitable in the first quarter of fiscal 1997," chairman Stephen Russell said in a statement, adding that operating expenses have been cut by close to $100,000 a week.
Earlier Monday, the company reported a net loss of $16.8 million or $2.13 a share in fiscal 1996, including a loss of $15.2 million, or $1.93 a share from discontinued operaitons.

The losses included $2.5 million from a fourth quarter disruption to a systems conversion, $800,000 from senior management changes and $1.8 million in accelerated damage repairs and insurance related issues, the company said.
